help_libraries: From Home, open Books, Movies or Music. Use Libraries to switch libraries and Catalogue → Home to return to the start screen. All books, All movies and All music include every collection in the current library.
help_collections: Create a collection with Catalogue → New collection…, then right-click the collection and choose Add a folder…. Select a collection, source or folder to narrow the results. Sync from the context menu for a collection or source. The status bar keeps your scope and shows progress on another line.
help_search: Search by name, path, title or author in the Search field. Title and author searches use indexed metadata. Under Search → Filter by extension…, select Books, Movies or your own extensions, then Apply. Each collection and each library overview remembers its own filter.
help_views: Use View to switch between List and Grid. In List, the Details pane follows the selection. Sorting and pagination work in both views. Text size commands adjust the interface while keeping images at the same dimensions.
help_tags: Right-click a result to manage its tags or add it to favourites. Favourites and My shelves show classified files from across the current library’s collections.
help_backup: In Catalogue, choose Back up catalogue… to copy the catalogue and its classifications. Restore a backup… restores the saved data and preferences without scanning the source folders again. Source files stay in their folders.
shortcut_home: Tab moves focus between controls. Press Enter or Space to open the focused library.
shortcut_bar: Press Alt alone to show or hide underlined letters. F10 focuses the menu bar, starting with Libraries. Press ← or → to choose a menu, then Enter to open it. Esc hides the cues and restores focus. Shortcuts work with the cues hidden. Alt+L opens Libraries, Alt+C Catalogue, Alt+S Search, Alt+V View, Alt+G Language and Alt+H Help.
shortcut_menu: Use ↑ and ↓ to move through entries, Home and End to go to the first or last. Enter or Space activates the selection. → opens a selected submenu and ← returns to its parent. On a top-level menu, ← and → switch to its neighbour. Esc closes the current panel or leaves the menu bar.
shortcut_context: Shift+F10 or the Menu key opens commands for the active item in the tree, List, Grid or expanded formats table.
shortcut_grid: The four arrow keys move the selection between tiles when the Grid has focus.
shortcut_larger: In the main window, press Ctrl++ or Ctrl+=. On AZERTY, use Ctrl+Shift on the =/+ key to type +. Ctrl with + on the numeric keypad works too.
shortcut_smaller: Ctrl+−. On AZERTY, use the −/6 key without Shift or use − on the numeric keypad.
shortcut_default: Ctrl+0. On AZERTY, use Ctrl+à without Shift on the 0/à key, or Ctrl+0 on the numeric keypad.
shortcut_help: ↑ and ↓ scroll the text, and Page Up and Page Down move by a page. Home and End go to the start and end. Tab moves to the buttons and Esc closes the window.
brand_site_error: Could not open the {brand} website in the browser.
